Fonts used by the Easy Strip's HOLOGRAM look, built into the plugin.

  Barlow Condensed (Medium, SemiBold, Bold)  - labels, values, the ticker
  Orbitron (Bold, made from the variable font at weight 700) - the AARDVARK EASY STRIP name

Both are free under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL-Barlow.txt, OFL-Orbitron.txt):
they can be built into software and shared or sold with it; the licence text goes along
if the fonts themselves are passed on. Downloaded from github.com/google/fonts.
